candidates.label: Oath by the honoured Quran framing the surah
candidates.definition: In 50:1: Qaf; by the honoured Quran.

evidence.excerpt: قٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡمَجِيدِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Resurrection denied as distant despite divine retaining record
candidates.definition: In 50:3-4: When we have died and have become dust we will return to life? That is a distant return; We know what the earth diminishes of them and with Us is a retaining record.

evidence.excerpt: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗاۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجۡعُۢ بَعِيدٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظُۢ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Cosmic signs of structured heaven and productive earth as insight and reminder
candidates.definition: In 50:6-8: Have they not looked at the heaven above them how We structured it and adorned it and it has no rifts; and the earth We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein of every beautiful kind giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns.

evidence.excerpt: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: تَبۡصِرَةٗ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبۡدٖ مُّنِيبٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Blessed rain reviving dead land as resurrection parallel
candidates.definition: In 50:9-11: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest and lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers as provision for the servants and We have given life thereby to a dead land; thus is the resurrection.

evidence.excerpt: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ مُّبَٰرَكٗا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٖ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتٖ لَّهَا طَلۡعٞ نَّضِيدٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: رِّزۡقٗا لِّلۡعِبَادِۖ وَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخُرُوجُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Nine prior communities named as deniers with justly fulfilled threat
candidates.definition: In 50:12-14: The people of Noah denied before them and the companions of the well and Thamud and Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot and the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'; all denied the messengers so My threat was justly fulfilled.

evidence.excerpt: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَعَادٞ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ وَإِخۡوَٰنُ لُوطٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖۚ كُلّٞ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Divine proximity closer than the jugular vein with soul-whispering known
candidates.definition: In 50:16: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him and We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفۡسُهُۥۖ وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِيدِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Dual recording angels capturing every uttered word
candidates.definition: In 50:17-18: When the two receivers receive seated on the right and on the left; man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared.

evidence.excerpt: إِذۡ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلۡمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: مَّا يَلۡفِظُ مِن قَوۡلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيۡهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Cover removed and sight sharpened on the Day of threat
candidates.definition: In 50:22: You were certainly in unmindfulness of this and We have removed from you your cover so your sight this Day is sharp.

evidence.excerpt: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدٞ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Hell asking for more while Paradise brought near to the righteous
candidates.definition: In 50:30-31: On the Day We will say to Hell have you been filled and it will say are there some more; and Paradise will be brought near to the righteous not far.

evidence.excerpt: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٍ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Creation in six days without weariness affirming divine capacity
candidates.definition: In 50:38: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days and there touched Us no weariness.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٖ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Timed praise commanded alongside patience over their words
candidates.definition: In 50:39-40: So be patient over what they say and exalt with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting and in part of the night exalt Him and after prostration.

evidence.excerpt: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَأَدۡبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Reminder by Quran limited to whoever fears the divine threat
candidates.definition: In 50:45: We are most knowing of what they say and you are not over them a tyrant; but remind by the Quran whoever fears My threat.

evidence.excerpt: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارٖۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
